scope: I / Code Synopsis reference and lifecycle invariant
admission: Resolved: I has default admission in every Scope Unit within Subject bounds.
form_invariant: A Code Synopsis faithfully describes the context and state of the actual code at one or more ordinary Markdown-link code locations. Each link is unambiguous in its Project context. When an applicable Project.Settings.Code-Root Locator is declared, the link is resolved against it. A link may include an anchor, and an observed content digest may be recorded when a particular observation needs to be pinned. The referenced code remains the truth of actual implementation. A difference from the synopsis or from an optional specification is neutral until assessment identifies a matter requiring resolution as a Concern. A Code Synopsis reuses the ordinary Atom identity, Status, Version, Updated At, and archival lifecycle. Refresh process, Task Run, and automatic synchronization remain Engine-workflow concerns.
form_text_fragment:
#### Code references

A Code Synopsis faithfully describes the context and state of the actual code at one or more ordinary Markdown-link code locations. Each link is unambiguous in its Project context. When an applicable Project.Settings.Code-Root Locator is declared, the link is resolved against it. A link may include an anchor, and an observed content digest may be recorded when a particular observation needs to be pinned.

The referenced code remains the truth of actual implementation. A difference from the synopsis or from an optional specification is neutral until assessment identifies a matter requiring resolution as a Concern.

A Code Synopsis reuses the ordinary Atom identity, Status, Version, Updated At, and archival lifecycle. Refresh process, Task Run, and automatic synchronization remain Engine-workflow concerns.

ordinary_markdown_contract.minimum: One or more unambiguous Project-context code-location links in ordinary Claim text.
ordinary_markdown_contract.code_root: Resolve against Project.Settings.Code-Root Locator only when that Setting is declared.

contributes_to.basis: CA-R-2508 gives every Atom 0+ outgoing CONTRIBUTES_TO permissions; CA-R-3001 defines the direct relation Atom -> Atom.
contributes_to.result: An I / Code Synopsis may optionally contribute to a Task, Analysis & Advisory Atom, or Requirement Atom when the contribution is true. No link is required, and contribution is not satisfaction.

rationale_for.direction: Analysis & Advisory Atom of Form Rationale -> explained Atom
rationale_for.result: It may target a Code Synopsis but does not grant Code Synopsis an outgoing rationale_for role.

concern_about.result: It may target the governed entity concerned after assessment, but does not grant Code Synopsis an outgoing concern_about role.

handoff: No human blocker remains in the reference/lifecycle lane. Root can integrate the form invariant; Engine-workflow owners retain refresh, Task Run, and synchronization behavior.
